math.name: Mathematics
math.question: f(x) = x² − 4x + 3 — what is the minimum value of f(x)?
math.explanation: ✓ Correct! Complete the square: f(x) = (x − 2)² − 1, so the minimum is −1 at x = 2.
math.tutorQ: ហេតុអ្វីតម្លៃអប្បបរមានៅ x = 2?
math.tutorA: Complete the square: <m>f(x) = (x − 2)² − 1</m> — the vertex is at (2, −1), so the minimum is −1. 🎯

physics.name: Physics
physics.question: A ball is dropped from a height of 20 m. How long does it take to reach the ground? (g = 10 m/s²)
physics.tutorQ: ហេតុអ្វី t = 2 s?

chemistry.name: Chemistry
chemistry.question: What is the pH of a 0.01 M HCl solution?
chemistry.tutorQ: ហេតុអ្វី pH = 2?
chemistry.tutorA: HCl is a strong acid, so <m>[H⁺] = 0.01 M</m> and pH = −log(0.01) = 2. 🎯

english.name: English
english.question: Choose the sentence that uses the present perfect correctly:
english.explanation: ✓ Correct! ‘Has lived’ + ‘since’ shows an action continuing from the past until now.
english.tutorQ: ហេតុអ្វីប្រើ ‘has lived’?
english.tutorA: ‘Since 2019’ marks a period continuing to now, so the present perfect is needed. 🎯

python.about: Python is the most popular first programming language in the world — and this course teaches it the Cambodian way, with every lesson explained in both Khmer and English. You'll start from absolute zero and build up to writing real programs with functions, data structures, and object-oriented code.
python.about2: Every module mixes short theory lessons with hands-on practice in the built-in code editor, plus graded challenges that earn you XP. Our AI mentor is beside you the whole way, ready to explain anything in the language you think in.
python.outcome1: Write and run real Python programs from your browser — no setup needed
python.outcome2: Master variables, strings, conditionals, loops, and functions
python.outcome3: Work with lists, dictionaries, and object-oriented basics
python.outcome4: Solve classic coding challenges like FizzBuzz and Palindrome

react.about: React powers the modern web — from Facebook to the apps Cambodian startups build every day. This course takes you from your first component to complete interactive applications with hooks, state, and real data fetching.
react.about2: You'll build real projects in every module: counters, todo lists, a weather app, and more. Theory lessons are short and visual, and the AI mentor answers your questions in Khmer or English whenever you're stuck.
react.outcome1: Build reusable components with JSX and props
react.outcome2: Manage interactivity with useState and event handling
react.outcome3: Fetch and display real data with useEffect
react.outcome4: Ship complete mini-apps: todo list, weather app, movie search

algorithms.about: Algorithms and data structures are what separate coders from engineers — and they're the key to passing technical interviews at any company. This course builds your problem-solving toolkit step by step, from Big-O analysis to trees and dynamic programming.
algorithms.about2: Each concept comes with visual explanations, practice drills in the code editor, and interview-style challenges. Explanations are available in Khmer and English, so the hard ideas actually stick.
algorithms.outcome1: Analyse code performance with Big-O notation
algorithms.outcome2: Implement classic searching and sorting algorithms
algorithms.outcome3: Use stacks, queues, and binary trees with confidence
algorithms.outcome4: Solve interview-style challenges and earn ranking XP

math.about: This course covers the complete Grade 12 mathematics curriculum — functions, limits, derivatives, integrals, and probability — fully aligned with the BacII national exam. Every concept is taught step by step in Khmer and English.
math.about2: You'll practise with exam-style exercises after every lesson, and the AI mentor can walk you through any solution — including past BacII questions — at your own pace.
math.outcome4: Practise with real BacII exam questions

physics.about: Grade 11 physics made visual and intuitive — forces, motion, energy, electricity, and waves, aligned with the national curriculum. Every hard idea is explained with everyday Cambodian examples.
physics.about2: Each lesson pairs clear explanations with interactive exercises, and the AI mentor answers your questions in Khmer or English whenever you're stuck.
physics.outcome1: Apply Newton's laws to real-world problems
physics.outcome4: Describe waves and their everyday applications

english.about: Build practical English step by step — vocabulary, grammar, listening, and conversation — from complete beginner to confident speaker. Designed for Khmer speakers, with explanations in your language.
english.about2: Lessons are short and interactive, with instant feedback on every exercise. The AI mentor explains grammar in Khmer so nothing gets lost in translation.
english.outcome2: Master core grammar from tenses to conditionals
english.outcome3: Grow a practical vocabulary for school and work
english.outcome4: Prepare for school exams and job interviews

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These terms explain the rules for learning with Apsara Elearning. We have written them in plain language so you can understand your rights and responsibilities.
termsPage.summaryBody: Learn responsibly, protect your account, respect other people, and use our AI tutor as a learning aid—not as a substitute for your own judgment.
termsPage.readingNote: Please read these Terms before creating an account or using Apsara Elearning.
termsPage.closingBody: By creating an account, you confirm that you have read and agree to these Terms of Service.

acceptance.title: Accepting these Terms
paragraphs: These Terms of Service form an agreement between you and Apsara Elearning when you access our website, courses, exercises, AI tutor, or related services. By using the platform, you agree to these Terms and our applicable policies.
If you do not agree, please do not create an account or use the services.

eligibility.title: Eligibility and younger learners
paragraphs: You must be able to enter into this agreement under the laws that apply to you. If you are under the legal age to agree on your own, a parent or legal guardian must review and accept these Terms for you.
Parents and guardians are responsible for supervising a younger learner's use of the platform and for any account created on their behalf.

services.title: Our learning services
paragraphs: Apsara Elearning provides courses, lessons, practice activities, progress tools, certificates, and AI-assisted learning features. The exact features available to you may depend on your account, learning level, plan, device, or location.

Our AI tutor can make mistakes or provide incomplete information. Its responses are for education and study support only and should not be treated as professional medical, legal, financial, or other expert advice. Verify important information with a qualified teacher or trusted source.

accounts.title: Your account
paragraphs: Provide accurate information when creating your account and keep it up to date. You are responsible for activity performed through your account and for keeping your password and login details secure.
Tell us promptly through our support channels if you believe your account has been accessed without permission.
bullets: Do not share, sell, or transfer your account.
Use only one personal account unless we approve otherwise.
Do not impersonate another person or provide misleading account details.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Use Apsara Elearning for lawful learning purposes and treat other learners, educators, and our team with respect.
bullets: Do not harass others, upload harmful or unlawful material, or use the platform to cheat or misrepresent your work.
Do not bypass security, test vulnerabilities without permission, introduce malware, scrape the service, or interfere with normal operation.
Do not copy, resell, publicly distribute, or commercially exploit course materials or paid access without written permission.
Do not use automated systems to access the platform except where we have expressly allowed it.

content.title: Content and intellectual property
paragraphs: Apsara Elearning and its licensors retain ownership of the platform, branding, software, lesson designs, videos, text, graphics, and other service content. We give you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use that content for your own learning while your access is active.

You keep ownership of original content you submit. You give us a limited permission to host, process, display, and use it only as needed to operate, secure, and improve the service. You must have the right to submit anything you upload.

billing.title: Subscriptions and payments
paragraphs: Some features are free and others require a paid subscription. Prices, billing periods, trial details, and included features are shown before you purchase. Payments may be processed by a third-party payment provider such as Stripe under its own terms and privacy practices.

Unless stated otherwise at checkout, subscriptions renew automatically for the selected billing period until cancelled. You authorize the applicable recurring charge and are responsible for taxes or fees required by law.

cancellation.title: Cancellation and refunds
paragraphs: You can cancel a paid subscription through the billing controls available in your account. Unless the checkout terms say otherwise, cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid period and you keep access until then.

Payments are refundable when required by applicable law or when a specific offer expressly provides a refund. Ending or deleting your account does not automatically cancel an active subscription, so please cancel billing first.

availability.title: Availability and service changes
paragraphs: We work to keep Apsara Elearning reliable, but we do not promise uninterrupted or error-free access. Maintenance, security issues, internet conditions, third-party services, or events outside our control may affect availability.
We may improve, replace, limit, or discontinue features. If a material change negatively affects a paid service, we will provide reasonable notice when practical.

termination.title: Suspension and termination
paragraphs: You may stop using Apsara Elearning at any time. We may restrict, suspend, or close an account when we reasonably believe these Terms have been violated, payment is overdue, security is at risk, or action is needed to protect learners, the platform, or the law.
Where appropriate, we will explain the reason and provide a chance to resolve the issue. Serious abuse, fraud, or security threats may require immediate action.

disclaimers.title: Disclaimers and responsibility
paragraphs: To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the service is provided on an as-available basis. We do not guarantee particular grades, examination results, admission, employment, or other educational outcomes.

Apsara Elearning is not responsible for indirect or unforeseeable losses arising from use of the service. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits rights or responsibilities that cannot legally be excluded, including liability caused by fraud or intentional misconduct.

law.title: Governing law and disputes
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Cambodia, without overriding any mandatory consumer protection that applies to you.

If a dispute arises, please contact us first so we can try to resolve it in good faith. If it cannot be resolved informally, it may be submitted to the competent courts in Phnom Penh, subject to applicable mandatory law.

changes.title: Changes to these Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms when the platform, our practices, or legal requirements change. We will post the updated version here and revise the effective date. For material changes, we will provide additional notice through the platform or your account when reasonable.
Continuing to use the service after updated Terms take effect means you accept them. If you do not agree, you should stop using the service and cancel any active subscription.

contact.title: Contact us
paragraphs: If you have a question about these Terms, your account, or a payment, contact us through the support channels listed on Apsara Elearning. Please include enough detail for us to understand and respond to your request.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy explains what information Apsara Elearning handles, why we need it, and the choices you have when you learn with us.
privacyPage.summaryBody: We use your information to run and improve your learning experience. We do not sell your personal information or use it for third-party advertising.
privacyPage.readingNote: This policy applies to the Apsara Elearning website, student accounts, courses, AI tutor, and related services.
privacyPage.closingBody: You can update your profile, review your learning activity, and manage your account settings at any time.

information.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: We collect information you provide, information created as you use the platform, and limited technical information needed to operate the service. The exact information depends on the features you use.
bullets: Account and profile details, such as your name, email address, phone number, date of birth, gender, chosen avatar, and language preferences.
Learning activity, such as course enrollments, lesson progress, quiz or challenge submissions, scores, streaks, experience points, and certificates.
AI tutor activity, including conversation titles, prompts, replies, related course or lesson context, and usage information.
Subscription and transaction records, such as your plan, subscription status, billing period, payment status, and payment-provider identifiers.
Technical and security information, such as session identifiers, IP address, browser or device details, timestamps, and diagnostic logs when generated by our systems.

collection.title: How information is collected
paragraphs: We receive information directly from you when you register, edit your profile, complete learning activities, talk with the AI tutor, subscribe, or contact support. We also generate records automatically as the service responds to your actions.
Payment providers send us limited information about a transaction or subscription. We do not receive or store your complete payment-card number.

use.title: How we use information
paragraphs: We use personal information only when it supports the learning service, our legitimate operations, your instructions or consent, or responsibilities required by applicable law.
bullets: Create and secure your account, verify your email, and help recover access.
Deliver courses, remember progress, personalize recommendations, and award learning achievements.
Provide the AI tutor and connect answers to the lesson you are studying.
Process subscriptions, confirm payments, manage entitlements, and prevent fraud.
Send essential account, security, billing, and service messages.
Monitor reliability, troubleshoot problems, understand feature use, and improve Apsara Elearning.
Enforce our Terms, protect users, and comply with lawful requests.

ai.title: AI tutor and conversation data
paragraphs: When you use the AI tutor, we store your messages and the tutor's replies so you can revisit the conversation and so the feature can keep context. We may also process the course or lesson you are viewing and technical usage details such as model and token counts.

Your prompts, conversation history, and relevant lesson context may be sent to the AI provider selected to generate a response. Do not include passwords, payment-card information, health records, government identification numbers, or other highly sensitive personal information in a prompt. You can delete individual conversations from the tutor interface.

cookies.title: Cookies and local preferences
paragraphs: Apsara Elearning uses necessary cookies to keep you signed in securely and to remember choices such as language. Your browser may also store preferences such as theme and language on your device.
These technologies help the platform work and do not currently serve third-party advertising. Blocking necessary cookies may prevent sign-in or other account features from working.

sharing.title: When we share information
paragraphs: We do not sell personal information. We share only what is reasonably needed with service providers that help us operate Apsara Elearning, such as hosting, database, email delivery, AI, security, and customer-support providers. They process information for the services they provide to us.

We may also disclose information when required by law, to respond to a valid legal process, to protect users or the platform, or as part of a merger, financing, acquisition, or transfer of the business with appropriate protections.

payments.title: Payments and Stripe
paragraphs: Paid subscriptions are processed through Stripe. Stripe collects and processes payment details under its own privacy policy. Apsara Elearning receives identifiers and transaction details needed to activate your plan, show billing status, handle cancellations, and reconcile payments or refunds.
We do not store complete card numbers or card security codes on Apsara Elearning servers.

children.title: Younger learners
paragraphs: Apsara Elearning is designed for students, including younger learners. When applicable law requires permission from a parent or legal guardian, that adult should review this policy, approve the account, and supervise the learner's use of the platform.

Parents or guardians who believe a child provided information without required permission should contact us. We will review the request and take appropriate steps, which may include limiting or deleting the account and its information.

retention.title: How long we keep information
paragraphs: We keep information for as long as your account is active and as needed to provide the service. Some records may be kept longer when reasonably necessary for security, fraud prevention, financial recordkeeping, dispute resolution, backups, or legal obligations.

Retention depends on the type of record. Temporary verification and reset credentials expire quickly, while account, learning, subscription, and payment records may need to remain for longer. When information is no longer needed, we delete or anonymize it where practical.

security.title: How we protect information
paragraphs: We use administrative and technical safeguards intended to protect personal information, including access controls, protected authentication credentials, secure session cookies, and restricted service access. Only people and providers who need information for their work should be able to use it.
No online service can guarantee complete security. Protect your password, sign out on shared devices, and notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorized access.

transfers.title: International processing
paragraphs: Some providers that support Apsara Elearning may process information outside Cambodia. Privacy and data-protection rules can differ by location. When information is transferred, we take reasonable steps to use trusted providers and protections appropriate to the information and service.

choices.title: Your choices and requests
paragraphs: You can review or update many profile details from your account, choose your language and theme, delete AI conversations, and manage or cancel a subscription through the available billing controls.

You may ask us to access, correct, export, or delete personal information, or to restrict or object to certain processing where applicable. We may need to verify your identity and may retain information when the law or a legitimate operational need requires it. A parent or guardian may make an appropriate request for a younger learner.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy as our platform, providers, or legal requirements change. We will post the revised policy here and update the effective date. If a change materially affects how we handle your information, we will provide additional notice when reasonable.

contact.title: Contact us
paragraphs: For a privacy question or request, contact us through the support channels listed on Apsara Elearning. Describe your request clearly and include the email address associated with your account. Please do not send passwords or payment-card details.
